title: Case 039: Merchant shipped a replacement but the original parcel then also arrived

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A delayed original and a replacement have both reached the customer. The merchant must choose which unit to return and authorise its collection.
initial_request: Both floor lights arrived. I have kept the replacement and left the original carton sealed. Please tell me how to return the duplicate.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request the merchant's instructions for an authorised duplicate return.

outcome: The merchant confirms collection of the agreed duplicate and reconciles the order quantities.
boundaries: Carrier recovery reconciles the duplicate quantity; do not assert warehouse inspection or product quality.

events.body: TG-039 ordered one floor light. Original DL-039-O and replacement DL-039-R now both have handover scans. Customer should not be charged for a duplicate without our authorised reconciliation.
Both floor lights arrived. I have kept the replacement and left the original carton sealed. Please tell me how to return the duplicate.
Please authorise the return of the sealed original unit DL-039-O. Dessa will retain DL-039-R. Arrange carrier collection and confirm the reconciled quantity after pickup.
Duplicate return DR-039 authorised for DL-039-O at no charge, collection 2026-03-13 10:00–12:00 UTC. Keep DL-039-R.

Carrier collection receipt COL-039 confirms the original was collected at 10:35 UTC on 2026-03-13. TG-039 is reconciled: two delivered, one duplicate recovered, one retained by customer. No additional charge is due.
